caption:
Two war machines just leveled Times Square.
Seedance 2.5 choreographed every hit itself.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: photoreal live-action blockbuster VFX, two giant mechanical warriors in a real Times Square, New York, bright midday sun, blue sky, crisp hard shadows, neutral daylight grade, heavy motion blur on fast moves, 35mm anamorphic lens feel. Camera feel: aggressive chase-cam that tracks the fighters through the air, short heavy camera jolts on every impact, then a slow-motion close-up for the kill and a top-down drone view for the aftermath. Pacing: relentless, 10 fast shots, almost all of the fight airborne several stories above the street; the only slow moment is the final cut. No sparks, no glowing particles, no blood, no on-screen text, no readable logos on the billboards.

CHARACTERS:
- A, THE MECH SAMURAI (hero): a hulking humanoid armored machine, about 2.5 m tall. Gunmetal-black armor plates with deep violet panels and acid yellow-green plates printed with black round dots; a horned black helmet with two short swept-back horns; a bulky mechanical backpack with black hoses and pistons; a ragged black cloth half-cape hanging from the back; heavy armored boots; wields TWO long silver katanas, one in each hand. Signature in every shot: the violet and dotted yellow-green armor and the two katanas.
- B, THE MECHANICAL REAPER (villain): a taller (about 3.5 m), gaunt mechanical reaper. Face: an ivory-white ceramic deer-skull mask with a red painted crosshair circle on the forehead, red painted streaks down the cheeks and two glowing red eyes; huge branching ivory antlers with red tips; long tattered white-and-crimson cloth robes and streamers that whip in the wind; underneath, a bronze and gunmetal chassis of gears, cables, round red lens-like discs on the chest and hanging chains with brass medallions; carries an enormous scythe with a dark crimson curved blade and a small red lantern-vessel hanging from it. B can dissolve into a cloud of dense BLACK MIST and reassemble elsewhere. Signature in every shot: the white deer-skull mask with antlers and the red-white tattered robes.

LOCATION: Times Square, Manhattan, midday: giant LED billboards (one huge screen glowing blue and white), tall stone and brick office buildings with rows of windows, green construction fences and wooden scaffolding on rooftops, a long straight avenue running into the distance with yellow taxis, crosswalks and tiny pedestrians far below. Damage stays and accumulates: shattered windows, dust, a crater in the street.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.0) — Thrown into the air. Starts already mid-action. Camera low at street level beside the asphalt: A skids backward toward camera under a sidewalk scaffold shed, boots tearing a trench in the asphalt; at 00:00.5 A slams into a building column in a burst of pale gray dust and concrete chunks (camera jolts); at 00:01.0 A rebounds off the wall beside a giant billboard and launches upward; the camera swings up behind A's right shoulder as A flies high over the avenue at 00:01.5, the whole of Times Square and the long avenue visible far below. MUST SHOW: a dense cloud of black mist condensing in the air ahead of A on the right side of frame.
SHOT 2 (00:02.0-00:04.0) — Missed strike. Wide lateral tracking shot: A (left) and B (right) meet in midair high above an intersection, B's robes streaming; A slashes, B dissolves and A passes through empty air past a rooftop with a green construction fence (00:02.5). Sharp upward pan at 00:03.0: low angle on A silhouetted against a gigantic blue-and-white LED billboard, katanas spread, B a red-white shape diving from the top-left corner; at 00:03.5 the impact throws A into a dark LED panel framework that buckles into rigid black rectangles.
SHOT 3 (00:04.0-00:05.4) — Clash on the facade. Side tracking shot along a tan stone building facade, the busy street far below on the left: B lunges in from the right swinging the scythe, A blocks with both katanas (00:04.5, B's deer-skull mask and antlers clearly visible right next to A); B's blow launches A horizontally across the frame into the windows (00:05.0, strong motion blur).
SHOT 4 (00:05.4-00:06.3) — Inside the office. Interior of an empty dim office floor: the window bursts and the room fills with a rolling gray dust cloud under a flickering ceiling fluorescent tube; A lands in a low sliding crouch on the floor, both katanas held out, bright windows behind.
SHOT 5 (00:06.3-00:07.3) — Bursting out. Exterior wide: A explodes out of the stone facade in a cloud of debris and leaps into open air, modern glass skyscrapers of Midtown in the background, blue sky; MUST SHOW: B re-forming from a swirl of black mist in the air at lower right, then dashing up toward A.
SHOT 6 (00:07.3-00:08.8) — Midair duel. Medium tracking shot between the buildings: A and B collide in midair, A's katana against B's scythe shaft; the crimson scythe blade sweeps over A's head with its little red lantern swinging; A is kicked and spins head-over-heels (00:08.0), then is flung backward toward the buildings in heavy motion blur (00:08.5).
SHOT 7 (00:08.8-00:10.0) — Through the scaffolding. High angle: A crashes through rooftop wooden scaffolding at the corner of a tall stone building in a burst of splintered planks and dust; at 00:09.5 the camera looks steeply down past A: B dives from the top of frame toward A, the street with red and blue billboards far below.
SHOT 8 (00:10.0-00:11.9) — The dive. Top-down drone view looking straight down at the street: A drops from a rooftop ledge, katanas out, falling toward a fresh round crater blasted in the asphalt, pale dust ring around it; B's small figure vanishes into black mist on the street; A free-falls past the camera toward the crater, tiny pedestrians and red storefronts at the edges.
SHOT 9 (00:11.9-00:13.9) — The final cut, slow motion. Extreme close-up: one katana slices horizontally across B's chest in a blur (00:12.0); then a locked-off close-up on B's ivory deer-skull mask, the silver katana blade held flat across the bottom of the frame, B's red eyes glowing (00:12.5) and then going dark (00:13.0); at 00:13.5 the mask splits down the middle, revealing gunmetal gears, pistons and cables inside. MUST SHOW: the red crosshair circle on the white skull forehead, centered in frame.
SHOT 10 (00:13.9-00:15.3) — Breakdown. Top-down view straight down on the cratered street: B's body bursts apart outward into hundreds of solid pieces: gears, brass medallions, white ceramic antler fragments, red cloth shreds, chains; at 00:14.5 the camera rises slightly as the debris lies scattered across the cracked asphalt and pale gray dust slowly settles.

SOUND: no dialogue. Hybrid cinematic percussion score with deep booms on every hit (no song). Asphalt ripping and concrete crash (shot 1), sword whoosh and a hollow mist whoosh when B vanishes, LED panels cracking (shot 2), heavy metal-on-metal clang (shot 3), glass shatter and muffled dust roar inside (shot 4), debris explosion (shot 5), rapid clangs and a kick thud (shot 6), splintering wood (shot 7), rushing wind on the dive (shot 8), near-silence in the slow motion with one sharp ringing blade slice and a ceramic crack (shot 9), a final crunching metal burst and clattering parts (shot 10).
prompt_short: Photoreal blockbuster, 16:9, Times Square midday: a violet and yellow-green mech samurai with two katanas battles a white deer-skull mechanical reaper who teleports in black mist, airborne crashes, a slow-mo final slice.
